question: What distinguishes valid scripture and method from mere talk?
premises: Speech that does not ascend to own-awareness is no better than idle talk.
Only what unfolds within awareness has genuine validity.
inference: Therefore, scripture and method are valid only insofar as they unfold within own-awareness.
plain_english: What does not rise to own-awareness is no different from idle talk; that alone is scripture and that alone is method which unfolds within awareness.
